## PayloadOptions.onParseError property

Behavior when the request body cannot be parsed (SEC-02 / ADR-101): - 'reject' (default): throw an Exception carrying the HTTP status (400 malformed, 413 too large, 415 unsupported encoding); - 'empty': legacy behavior, log and fall back to `{}`<!-- -->. When unset, falls back to `app.security.payload.onParseError`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
onParseError?: 'reject' | 'empty';
```
